plain: Wrongful or careless conduct, especially by someone in a profession.

webster.text: Evil practice; illegal or immoral conduct; practice contrary to established rules.

example.quote: No person shall be allowed to plead in the courts of law in this State, except those who are authorized so to do by the house of assembly; and if any person so authorized shall be found guilty of malpractice before the house of assembly, they shall have power to suspend them.
